command.title: Chat copilot: read the chat in front

consent.question: Let the chat copilot read the window of {app} in front, once?

errors.blocked_target: This app is on the protected list (password managers, system security), so it is never captured.
errors.capture_failed: The window could not be captured.
errors.credential_window: A password field was focused, so the capture was blanked and nothing was read.
errors.declined: Capture not allowed. Nothing was read.
errors.draft_failed: The copilot could not finish. Try again.
errors.kill_switch: Automation is stopped by the kill switch. Release it in Settings → Automation to capture again.
errors.no_frontmost_app: No app window is in front. Switch to the chat and press the shortcut again.
errors.no_local_ocr: No on-device OCR engine is ready. Set one up in Settings → OCR; chat screenshots are never sent to cloud OCR.
errors.no_messages: No messages were found in the window. Open a conversation and try again.
errors.ocr_failed: On-device OCR could not read the window.
errors.screen_recording_required: Cognia needs the Screen Recording permission to read the chat window. Grant it in System Settings, then try again.
errors.self_window: Cognia was in front when the shortcut was pressed. Switch to the chat app and press it again.
errors.unsupported_platform: Reading another app's window is not supported on this system.

footer: Read once with on-device OCR. Nothing is typed into the chat app; copy a reply to use it.
overlayUnavailable: The chat copilot window could not open. Its permission prompt appears in the main window instead.

phase.thinking: Judging the conversation and drafting replies…

read.contactAmbiguous: More than one contact is named {name}, so no notes were used.
read.messages: Read {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} from {app}.

unsided.ambiguous: Some messages could not be placed on either side.
unsided.one_sided: Only one side of the conversation is visible, so the copilot can't tell which messages are yours.
unsided.single_column: This app shows everyone's messages in one column, so senders can't be told apart.
